rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives are single-paragraph suspensions of a specifically identified officer-promotion provision, limited “to the extent” it applies to named Navy corps and particular promotion grades, and ending at a stated time. C04 and C09 share the general statutory-suspension formula, but neither matches the child’s Navy promotion machinery and corps-specific limitation as closely as C10.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The second sentence of section 5762 (a) of title 10 of the United States Code ... is hereby suspended until June 30, 1957
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the operation of the provisions of paragraph (2) of section 308 (b) of the Officer Personnel Act of 1947 ... is hereby suspended until June 30 of the fiscal year following
shared_material.explanation: Both identify a precise statutory subdivision governing officer promotion and suspend its operation until a specified deadline.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to the extent that it relates to the number of officers that may be recommended for promotion to the grade of captain in the Civil Engineer Corps
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to the extent that such provisions are applicable to the Medical Corps and Dental Corps
shared_material.explanation: Both narrow the suspension through the distinctive “to the extent” construction to specified Navy staff corps; the child further narrows it to recommendations for promotion to captain.

shared_material.child_excerpt: relating to the method of determining the number of officers that may be recommended by the Secretary of the Navy for promotion to the grade of captain or commander
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The number to be furnished the board in respect to the temporary promotion of officers ... to the grades of captain and commander ... shall be determined by the Secretary of the Navy
shared_material.explanation: The directives address substantially the same administrative machinery: determining numbers of Navy officers considered or recommended for promotion to captain and commander.
